purpose: Bind the frozen V007 scientific design to the runtime, execution, independent reconstruction, and analysis components before any authorization.

primary_analysis.Y_definition: Y=1 when selected transformation is the branch enabling C; otherwise Y=0.
primary_analysis.confidence_interval: 95% CI by inversion of the permutation procedure

randomization.condition_assignment: restricted random permutation exactly 70/70/70 at pair level

runtime_binding.reasoning: must provide bounded observable A/B response

isolation_boundary.future_successor_information: treatment receives only the specified predecision structural rules; control and null do not receive future structure

power_planning.blocking_status: must be resolved before final sample-size freeze/authorization

required_pre_authorization_checks: canonical provider Git blob identity resolved
independent Executor-2 identity and independence verified
primary estimand and analysis identity verified
formal discrete power simulation completed or explicitly resolved by a documented design decision
explicit user authorization after all checks
authorization_rule: This contract does not authorize scientific execution.
